title: 龙泰资管郝洪：消费结构转变，服务支出强劲增长，年轻一代更重体验消费
speaker: How Home

segments.en: I think the consumer consumption which is measured in retail sales growth hasn't been performing as well as expected, you know, because in the first half of this year, the subsidies, you know, for people to buy electronic goods and also buy cars has been sort of removed.
segments.zh: 我认为以零售额增长衡量的消费表现不及预期，因为今年上半年，购买电子产品和汽车的补贴被取消了。

segments.en: So I think the EV sales alone, for example, this year, dragged down the sales retail sales growth by one and a half percentage point. And therefore, you know, the resulting figure is a flat year-on-year retail sales growth.
segments.zh: 仅电动汽车销售一项就拖累零售额增长1.5个百分点，导致零售额同比持平。

segments.en: But if you look at the service industry, though, you know, if you look at the service spending, right? So service spending year-on-year is up almost 6% and beating expectation.
segments.zh: 但如果你看服务业，服务支出同比增长近6%，超出预期。

segments.en: I tell you, it's telling us that, you know, people are actually spending more on service-related consumption rather than on goods consumption. So as a result, you know, you know, we will continue to see our spending on service continue to outpace service spending on goods.
segments.zh: 这表明人们实际上在服务相关消费上支出更多，而非商品消费。因此，服务支出将持续超过商品支出。

segments.en: And I think, you know, this after COVID, this days, the Chinese people has changed their spending habits. You know, many of them, especially the younger Chinese generation, is spending a lot more on experience-related consumption.
segments.zh: 我认为疫情后，中国人的消费习惯发生了变化。许多人，尤其是年轻一代，在体验式消费上支出更多。

segments.en: You know, for example, they're buying concert tickets, they're going out camping and also, you know, overseas ships are also on the rise as well. And so many of these spending are not recorded in the retail sales figure.
segments.zh: 例如，他们购买演唱会门票、去露营，海外旅行也在增加。这些支出很多并未计入零售额数据。
